items.title: Bills sign LB Otis Reese, put LB Demetirus Flannigan-Fowles on IR
items.summary: Linebacker Otis Reese spent some time on the Bills' practice squad last year and he's back in Buffalo trying to earn a spot on the roster this summer.
items.whyItMatters: It adds variety to the sports mix without turning the page into a full sports wire.

items.title: Pato consortium set for Northampton Town takeover
items.summary: Former AC Milan and Brazil forward Alexandre Pato is a member of a consortium which is set to buy a majority stake in League Two club Northampton Town, BBC Sport understands.
items.whyItMatters: Football creates regular global sports momentum and quick-return storylines.
